div.span:
for every FITS that exists
1. Normalize near 1450 Å rest (1700 Å backup)
2. Resample onto the DESI wavelength grid
3. eval() zeroes weights on Lyα-forest pixels (so they don't influence reconstruction)
4. Rebin the continuum to the observed frame
and rescale it onto the flux
5. recon_norm = flux / continuum
